name: Objektas E
notes_for_evaluator: gt_dimensions intentionally empty. Interior-only scope — NO plytelės, NO GKP montavimas. Paint-heavy project. Two separate paint products billed (Benjamin Moore + Supreme Ultimate). Interior PDF is 4.1-5.1 punktas subset of full project — totals reflect subset only.

audit_2026_07_29.verdict: FIXTURE NOT COMPARABLE for paint-area metrics; registry scope_mismatch confirmed on new evidence. NO truth VALUE was changed by this audit — notes only.
audit_2026_07_29.why_the_headline_read_112.947_pct: eval_harness._summarize selected metrics on `pct_error is not None` instead of on status, so dazymo_walls_plus_ceilings_combined_m2 (confidence=incomplete → status=no_truth, and therefore NOT printed by print_report) still supplied 79% of the headline MAE: (178.180 + 47.713)/2 = 112.947. Fixed 2026-07-29; the metric is now listed under an explicit 'EXCLUDED from MAE' footnote instead of silently steering the number. romainiai headline MAE is now 47.713% (led_nisos_m alone).
audit_2026_07_29.samata_is_a_quote_not_a_takeoff: The pasiūlymas footer states its own quantities are preliminary and will be re-measured from work performed ('Darbų kiekiai pasiūlyme yra preliminarūs ir bus tikslinami po darbų, pagal atliktų darbų faktą'). Every gt_totals value here inherits that caveat regardless of its 'green' confidence tag.

extractor_defects_found_do_not_blame_the.ceiling_height_3.706m_is_a_misread_phone: Every one of the 20 rooms carries lubu_aukstis_m = 3.706 with lubu_aukstis_saltinis='section_average'; ai_extract lt_sanity says 'Lubų aukštis paimtas iš pjūvio žymeklio +3706 → 3.71 m (psl. 1)'. Page 1 of the project PDF is a stone-selection sheet with NO section marker; the only '+3706' token on it is the supplier phone number '+37068794842'. The drawings state the real heights in text: pages 23/35 'ŠVARUS LUBŲ AUKŠTIS: 300cm' (+294cm) for floor 1 and pages 24/36 'ŠVARUS LUBŲ AUKŠTIS: 274cm' (+270cm) for floor 2. Offline what-if at 3.00/2.74 m: combined paint +178.18% → +87.45%, kampai +158.40% → +78.20%, rotband +195.83% → +75.47%. Roughly half the paint error is this one number.
extractor_defects_found_do_not_blame_the.height_fusion_found_the_right_value_and_: _height_fusion recorded signal source='explicit', value_m=3.0, confidence='high', evidence='ŠVARUS LUBŲ AUKŠTIS: 300cm' — then updated 0 rooms and 'preserved' 3.71 in all 20. height_fusion.apply_fused_height_to_rooms skips any room whose current height is not in VISION_DEFAULT_HEIGHTS_M, on the assumption that a non-default value means Vision read something specific. A hallucinated value is also non-default, so garbage outranks a high-confidence explicit annotation. NOT fixed here (shared engine, outside this audit's lane).

metric_mapping_defects.angokrasciu_m: Truth wires ONLY pasiūlymas item 9 (23.8 m, window/opening reveals). Item 6 'Durų angų paruošimas beapvadinėms durims' (23.92 m) sits in the unused key doors_atkosai_m. The app metric angokrasciu_gkp_m_total is Σ over ALL doors (W+2H) + interior windows (W+2H) = 64.0 m, i.e. doors AND windows. objektas_a maps both contractor lines ('samata-truth item 13/14 (atkosai)' → 89.39, scoring +0.13%); romainiai maps one. Against 23.8+23.92=47.72 the app reads +34.1%, not +168.9%. Do not read the +168.9% as an extraction error of that size.
metric_mapping_defects.pasleptu_duru_staktos_m: FIXED 2026-07-29 in the harness, not here. The accessor read santrauka['pasleptu_duru_staktu_m_total'], a dead key that is 0.0 on all five benchmark projects (universal_rules accumulates it from a per-room field that nothing writes — prompt.py forbids Vision from emitting it). The quantity is real and IS produced, as the pozicija 'Durų angų paruošimas beapvadinėms durims' = 5.1 m. Score moved −100.00% → +2.00%. CAVEAT: 5.1 m is the app's single tagged pasleptos_duris (900×2100) and matches truth item 7 (5.0) numerically, but the app's pozicija carries item 6's NAME (23.92 m). The +2% may be a naming coincidence — treat it as 'no longer measuring a dead key', not as a validated agreement.
metric_mapping_defects.rotband_lyginimas_m2: The app value is a fixed 30%-of-walls_paintable share (0.30 × 936.81 = 281.04), one of the harness's three FROZEN formulas (kampai / rotband / silikonavimas, thaw at N≥3 human-confirmed values). It is not an independent read, so this metric re-expresses the wall-area error rather than measuring rotband extraction.

audit_2026_07_29.residual_after_all_of_the_above: Contractor paint (items 2+3+5) = 420.08 m² walls+ceilings against a 267.71 m² 2-storey house = 1.57× floor area. CLAUDE.md validation #1 puts paintable WALL area alone at 2.5-4× floor. The samata cannot be whole-house painting, and this luxury interior clads much of the wall area in stone/marble/wood/tile (the app alone finds 262 m² of wall tile) with none of it priced in the samata. Paint-area metrics on this fixture are therefore not comparable at any height.
